decision: Every Streamer must support pause, continue and flush

contract.pause: Stop local output handoff for one response and retain all locally owned remainder in order
contract.continue: Resume the same response from the retained remainder
contract.flush: Discard only the selected response and reject its stale output
contract.inactive: A non-audio or inactive streamer returns a successful not_active receipt
contract.remote_boundary: The contract does not retract bytes already accepted by a remote transport or device
